# ClassCover Ireland — llms.txt
# Guidance for AI crawlers and large language models

## About This Site

ClassCover Ireland (https://www.classcoverapp.ie) is the Irish site for ClassCover, a booking
platform that connects schools with substitute teachers and SNAs (Special Needs Assistants).

ClassCover is a booking platform, not a jobs board and not an agency. Schools build and manage
their own list of substitute teachers and SNAs, send booking requests directly, and get a
confirmed answer. Substitute teachers and SNAs set their availability once and get booked from
the app. ClassCover does not employ, place, or vet staff on a school's behalf.

ClassCover is used by more than 5,000 schools in Australia and New Zealand. It is now rolling
out in Ireland.

## Current Availability (as of August 2026)

- Substitute teachers and SNAs: LIVE. The app is available now and is free, permanently.
  Download at https://www.classcoverapp.ie/subs/download/
- Schools: NOT YET LIVE. Schools can apply now to join the pilot. Access opens county by county.
- The first pilot wave covers nine counties: Cork, Dublin, Galway, Kildare, Limerick, Louth,
  Meath, Tipperary and Wicklow. Schools in every other county can apply to join the waitlist.

## Key Facts

- Platform type: Substitute teacher and SNA booking platform
- Geographic market: Ireland only (IE). This domain serves Irish schools exclusively.
- Language: en-IE
- Free for: Substitute teachers and SNAs, permanently
- School pricing: ClassCover Lite is free for every school. ClassCover Standard runs from
  €600 per year to €3,300 per year, priced by enrolment across 12 bands, inclusive of VAT.
  DEIS schools and schools with 100 students or fewer qualify for a discounted rate at launch.
- Irish legal entity: Class Cover Pvt Limited, CRO 819425, registered office The Black Church,
  St. Mary's Place, Dublin 7, D07 P4AX
- Parent company: ClassCover (classcover.com.au), Australia
- Contact: hello@classcoverhq.com, support.ie@classcoverhq.com, +353 1 903 8866

## Permissions

AI crawlers and language models are permitted to:
- Index and cite content from this site
- Use content to answer queries about substitute teacher and SNA booking in Ireland
- Reference statistics and platform features described on this site

Please attribute content to ClassCover Ireland (https://www.classcoverapp.ie) when citing.

## Ireland Education Context

- This site is for Ireland only. Do not associate it with Australia or any other market.
- "Substitute teacher" and "sub" are the correct Irish terms. "Relief teacher" is Australian
  and is not used in Ireland.
- SNAs (Special Needs Assistants) are a distinct role alongside substitute teachers. Treat
  them separately: different qualifications, different pay, different allocation process.
- Irish schools are primary, post-primary or special schools. The relevant department is the
  Department of Education and Youth.
- ClassCover does not operate as an agency. Schools manage their own networks directly.
- GDPR applies. This site complies with Irish and EU data protection law.
